Vertical: IT helpdesk/internal ITSM automation (SaaS product team). Primary ask: fast internal assistant for agents + a lightweight bot for first-touch triage.
Behavioral notes: product org is engineering heavy; PM quoted: "latency kills agent adoption" on 3/2 call.

Integration: tool-calls to ticket system (update-status, escalate, add-note), webhook auth via signed JWT. Want a path to on-prem/private deployment later for regulated customers.
Next admin items: security questionnaire answers (due 2026-03-16), send dedicated pricing worksheet, schedule internal architecture review with infra (week of 2026-03-15).
